  # Project Info
  
```{r}
if (file.exists("project_info.tsv")) {

project_info <- read_tsv("project_info.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)

project_info %>%
  kable(
    booktabs = TRUE,
    format = "latex",
    longtable = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position","scale_down"),
    font_size = 10
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "6cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "8cm")
  
} else {

  cat("Project Info not available (project_info.tsv not found)")

}
```

---

  # Metabarcoding Overview

This report summarizes metabarcoding results following preprocessing, clustering, taxonomic assignment, but before regional filers and final result curation done by the regional_remix step.

Briefly, metabarcoding process include the following rainbow_bridge steps in this order:

* blast
* zotus
* lulu
* taxonomy
* final

\newpage

The report includes:

* Sample-level read comparisons
* BLAST and LCA filtering metrics
* ASV (zOTU) retention across steps
* Taxonomic diversity summaries
* Abundance distributions
* Heatmaps of taxa across samples


	# Helper Scripts

```{r}
helper_data <- data.frame(
  `Helper Script` = c("plot_metabarcoding_results.R"),
  Process = c("Makes plots for the metabarcoding report")
)

helper_data %>%
  kable(booktabs = TRUE, format = "latex", col.names = c("Helper Script", "Process")) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position") %>%
  column_spec(1, italic = TRUE, color = "blue")
```
